summary: Real Messenger Corp filed a Form 6-K reporting the pricing and closing of a $4.0 million public offering of units at $0.70 per unit, each consisting of one Class A ordinary share (or pre-funded warrant) and one common warrant. The offering was conducted on a best-efforts basis via a placement agent, Maxim Group LLC, which received a 6.5% cash fee and placement agent warrants. Net proceeds are intended for potential M&A, working capital, and complementary investments. Insiders signed six-month lock-ups. This is a routine equity financing, not a special situation.
